verdict.rationale: CIPO's own site lists how-to guidance written as task descriptions: how to file a patent application, request and fast-track examination [cipo-docs-12], and how to pay maintenance fees or reinstate an application [cipo-docs-14]. It also offers a tool that generates a tailored IP-strategy guide [cipo-docs-22]. That points to task-oriented explainers beyond statute text, but the evidence is only link titles, so whether the content is plain-language and step-by-step is unverified. missing for 10: evidence the guides are written in plain language a non-lawyer can follow, actual step-by-step walkthrough content, equivalent explainers for trademarks/copyright beyond service-entry links, independent or hands-on corroboration of usability for founders.
